text:
lucas m: prepping a zero-downtime cutover for router in eu-central1 during the 22:00-23:30 UTC window. aim: blue->green swap with minimal overlap and clear rollback gates.

deepti: propose micro-steps because p95 has been spiky: 0.1%, 0.8%, 4%, 18%, 100%. 8-12m hold each. manual advance only.

rahul: agree. keep sticky-cookie active for first three steps (cookie name _rwd_sid), then disable affinity at 18%. note: model routing pinned to model=v3.0.0-canary. docs: https://docs.redwood/releases/v3.0.0

oncall-zoe: hard rollback triggers: absolute error-rate +0.6% for 4m, p95 >350ms for 5m, or any AZ with 502 spike >0.4%. If triggered run revert command and start drain.

ops-bot: preflight checklist: certs ok, health probe endpoint /_hc returns 200, config PR merged https://git.redwood/router-config/pull/478.

lucas m: rollback command (control plane):

curl -X POST https://router-api/v1/weights/set -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"weights":{"green":0}}'

deepti: drain policy on rollback: drain_seconds=45, keep trace sampling enabled for 20m after. also tag rollout_id=5245551234 on spans.

rahul: capacity reserve +30% in eu-central1 during window. autoscaler cooldown 6m. Ill validate reservations at 21:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout 5245551234 created. state: PREPARED. waiting for manual START.

lucas m: please ack with :thumbsup: if you will be present. I'll post a 30m preflight at 21:30 UTC in this thread.

deepti: :thumbsup:

rahul: :thumbsup: standing by to flip weights.

oncall-zoe: :thumbsup: oncall for the window.
